caption: The video captures an outdoor close-up of a small fire already burning on a flat tan cardboard sheet laid over dry, brownish grass. A pile of crumpled, blackened paper sits at the center of the sheet, actively flaming with bright orange-yellow tongues of fire. A large, out-of-focus beige vertical object occludes the left side throughout. The flames continuously flicker, rise, collapse, and reshape, while the brightest core shifts position over the pile. The fire footprint stays roughly the same size, and the charred pile does not translate across the sheet. Near the middle, a small bright tongue lifts briefly above the upper-left flames as the pattern continues to change. Handheld framing drifts slowly, sliding the blurry foreground left and revealing a printed cardboard box at the sheet edge.
